caption:
Three work costs people try to claim that the ATO says no to.

Gym membership: not claimable, unless strenuous physical activity is an essential, regular part of your job. Plain black work pants: conventional clothing isn't deductible, even if you only wear it to work. Driving from home to the office: normal trips between home and work are private, even long ones.

For 2025–26 returns.

Comment CLAIM and you'll be first to get The Claim Sheet when it lands in December.

General info only, not personal advice.
